factions.name: Crownlands
factions.look: Crownlands: chalk cliffs, hedged coastal farmland, pale stone castles with blue slate roofs. Palette azure, bone white, slate grey, muted gold. Wool, padded cloth, mail and plain practical steel; heraldry of a blue tower on white

factions.name: Thornwild
factions.look: Thornwild: old-growth coastal forest, moss, ferns, bracken, mist, stone circles. Palette moss green, bark brown, rust bracken, pale fog grey. Hide, bark, woven plant fibre, antler and bone; animals drawn as real animals

factions.name: Iron Reach
factions.look: Iron Reach: basalt mountains, quarries, mines, foundries and sea-facing batteries. Palette charcoal, iron grey, ochre dust, ember orange. Leather aprons, iron scale, soot and grime; constructs are riveted iron and stone, heavy and mechanical

factions.name: Tideborn
factions.look: Tideborn: underwater cities of coral and pearl, kelp forests, lagoons and tidal flats. Palette teal, turquoise, pearl white, coral pink. Tideborn are sea-dwelling people with fin-like ears and subtle gill lines, in shell, kelp and woven fibre; light falls in shafts from the surface

factions.name: Free Fleets
factions.look: Free Fleets: working ships, busy quays, open sea, coves and harbour taverns. Palette weathered wood, canvas, sea blue, faded reds. Sailors in practical working clothes; traders and privateers, not cartoon pirates; ships drawn with believable rigging

factions.name: Abyssal Choir
factions.look: Abyssal Choir: the deep ocean, trenches, sunken ruins and lonely night shores. Palette ink black, deep blue-violet, bone grey, with sparing cold bioluminescence (the one faction where glow is normal). Drowned cultists in sodden robes; creatures are deep-sea animals made vast and strange, unsettling rather than gory

factions.name: Harbor Leagues
factions.look: Harbor Leagues: merchant ports, lighthouses, guild halls, canals and quays. Palette warm sandstone, brass, harbour blue, lamplight amber. Officials, clerks and dockworkers in tan and blue; busy, lived-in civic spaces

factions.name: Neutral
factions.look: Neutral: roads, inns, moors, weather and ruins that belong to no faction. Palette earthy neutrals with the sky and sea doing the colour work. Travellers, mercenaries and ordinary animals; weather drawn as real weather
